crossRefs.note: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be…
for he had an only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed…
He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”
Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”
Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.
But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was…
He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”
Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus…
for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,
What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

translations.web: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
translations.bsb: And Jesus told the woman, “Your faith has saved you; go in peace.”
translations.kjv: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
translations.asv: And he said unto the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
